jobs.title: Corporate Development Manager/Sr Manager
jobs.description:
As part of Ecolab’s Corporate Development team, the Corporate Development Manager/Sr Manager is responsible for evaluating M&A opportunities and investments, preparing complex financial valuation models and analyzing strategic fit. The role also supports the preparation of materials for executive management review, coordination of the due diligence process and supporting negotiations.

This is a high-visibility position requiring analytical thinking, excellent project management skills, an understanding of M&A concepts, and strong attention to detail.

What You Will Do:
- Work with functional and business teams to develop financial forecasts and proper accounting treatment to incorporate into financial valuation models
- Conduct financial statement analysis to evaluate business performance
- Support and organize transaction due diligence process including request tracking, coordination of internal and external resources, and synthesis of due diligence findings
- Conduct research and in-depth analyses of companies, markets, and industries, and assess their attractiveness and strategic fit with Ecolab
- Coordinate Capital Authorization Requests and draft project presentations
- Manage ad-hoc strategic and financial analyses and projects as needed

Position Details:
- This position has onsite work expectations in St. Paul, MN
- Candidate must reside within commutable distance of  St. Paul, MN

Minimum Qualifications:
- MBA with 4 years of experience or Bachelor’s Degree in business or related field with 7 years of experience
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office to create both complex financial models and executive-level presentations
- Business acumen and understanding of the linkage between business strategy and financial performance
- Immigration sponsorship not available for this role

Preferred Qualifications:
- CFA or CPA
- Corporate development, strategic planning, consulting, finance, private equity and/or investment banking
- Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills
- Strong analytical and organization skills, high attention to detail, the ability to work independently

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range

The base salary range for this position is $107,600.00 - $161,500.00. This position is eligible for annual bonus pay based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst – Strategic Finance & Capital Planning
jobs.description:
Ecolab is seeking a highly motivated Senior Financial Analyst to support strategic finance activities across multiple business units and enterprise initiatives. This role will serve as a key business partner to finance leadership, providing financial planning, forecasting, CAPEX governance, reporting, and decision support for both ongoing operations and high-impact strategic projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial and accounting acumen with analytical thinking, business partnership skills, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

What You Will Do:
Capital Expenditure Management
- Own CAPEX forecasting, planning, tracking, and reporting processes.
- Partner with business leaders to evaluate capital investment requests and develop business cases.
- Monitor project spend against approved budgets and identify potential overspend risks.
- Ensure compliance with corporate capitalization policies and governance requirements.
- Analyze depreciation and asset impacts associated with new investments.

Strategic Finance & Business Partnering
- Conduct scenario modeling and financial impact analysis to support executive decision-making.
- Partner with commercial, operations, digital, accounting, and FP&A teams on cross-functional projects.
- Provide financial guidance and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Reporting & Analytics
- Develop and enhance executive dashboards, management reporting packages, and KPI reporting.
- Create presentations and leadership materials for senior management and executive reviews.
- Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and process enhancements.

Location Details:
- This position will be located in Greensboro, NC on a hybrid work schedule
- Candidate must reside within a commutable distance of Greensboro, NC

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
- 5 years of progressive finance, FP&A, accounting, or strategic finance experience
- Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills
- Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint capabilities
- Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams
- Excellent communication and presentation skills

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range

The pay range for this position is $85,900.00 - $128,900.00. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY

Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.

Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.

As demand for generative AI, high performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Role:
An exciting and challenging position exists as a Program Manager at CoolIT’s head office in Taipei, Taiwan . As a member of the Program Group, you would be accountable for the planning, development and launch of numerous new product introductions (NPI’s) for major datacenter OEM clients.

Responsibilities:
- Own end-to-end leadership of multiple complex and high-visibility NPI programs, ensuring delivery aligned with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality
requirements.
- Act as the primary program leader and escalation point for critical customer programs and strategic initiatives.
- Lead and influence global cross-functional teams (Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Sales) to drive alignment and execution across regions
- Drive adherence and continuous improvement of CoolIT’s Product Development Process, introducing best practices where needed.
- Partner closely with key customers and global business teams to shape program direction, support RFP/RFQ responses, and align on expectations.
- Work closely with global Business Development and Account Managers to respond to customer RFPs and RFQs.
- Develop and manage complex program plans, including integrated schedules, resource planning, risk mitigation strategies, and financial tracking.
- Proactively identify program risks and systemic issues and lead cross-functional resolution strategies with executive visibility when required.
- Establish clear program governance, reporting structures, and performance metrics across multiple concurrent projects.
- Manage stakeholder interactions and expectations, facilitate effective communication, and maintain alignment throughout the NPI process.
- Provide clear, executive-level program reporting and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Mentor and guide junior Program Managers to elevate overall team capability and execution quality.
- Facilitate customer and internal governance meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and accountability across
- Global travel required up to 10–20%.

Basic Qualifications
- Engineering degree, preferably in an electromechanical discipline
- 8–10+ years of experience in a product development role or program management within
- Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale, complex NPI programs in a global, matrixed organization.
- Extensive experience managing Tier-1 / hyperscale / multinational customers, including high expectations and tight timelines.
- Experience working with critical and demanding customers from large multinational organizations to provide timely updates and manage expectations. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with, influence and manage stakeholders at all levels of the organization, both internally and with customers.
- Strong ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels, driving decisions that
impact business outcomes.
- Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and customers.
- Proven capability in managing program financials, including budget control, cost tracking, and trade-off decisions.
- Advanced risk management and problem-solving skills, with a structured and proactive approach.
- Strong leadership presence with the ability to align diverse teams, resolve conflicts, and drive accountability.
- Strong cross-functional leader that takes a collaborative approach to tackle projects and overcome roadblocks.
- Ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously with competing priorities.
- High sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability for results

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in project management is desirable and PMP designation is considered an asset
- Experience with data center thermal management, liquid cooling, or high-performance computing systems is highly preferred.

WHY COOLIT?

We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.

We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.  Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.
Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.

jobs.title: Procurement Finance Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Procurement Finance Senior Manager is a key member of the Procurement Finance organization, serving as a commercial finance partner to Procurement leadership. This role mirrors Commercial Finance in mindset and rigor, with a primary focus on value creation, savings delivery, pricing and market intelligence, and decision support. The role acts as a co-pilot to Procurement and Division leaders, enabling decisions through robust savings analytics, planning, pricing and commodity insights, and forward-looking market insights.

How you'll make an impact:

Strategic Business Partnership
- Serve as a trusted finance partner to Global and Regional Procurement leaders.

- Translate procurement strategies into clear financial impact including P&L, cash flow.

- Proactively identify and support analytics for value creation opportunities.

Savings Management & Analytics
- Own financial governance of the procurement savings pipeline including validation.

- Develop savings analytics to support sourcing, strategic projects, and executive reviews.

- Partner with FP&A to ensure savings are reflected in forecasts and plans.

Pricing, Commodity & Market Insights
- Partner with divisions on pricing need and market intelligence for key raw materials.

- Provide forward-looking insights on commodity trends and inflationary pressures.

Financial Modeling & Decision Support
- Build financial models to support RFPs, sourcing decisions, and contract structures.

- Support scenario modeling, risk assessment, and sensitivity analysis.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

- 6–8 years of progressive finance experience.

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

- Proven business partnership, cross-functional collaboration, and communication skills.

Additional Qualifications:

- Experience in Commercial Finance, Procurement, or Supply Chain Finance.

- Experience working across global or regional teams.

- Beginner’s mindset for continuous improvement with an eye for Digitization

What’s   in it For You:

- Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary (Base pay & Variable Plan) and benefits package (private medical care, life insurance, stock purchase, lunch subsidy, sport cards).

- Work-Life Balance: Flexible working arrangements with hybrid model of work (approx. 60% from the office and 40% from home)

- Matrix Organization: Thrive in our matrix organization, working across Europe with various teams and cultural backgrounds.

- Collaborative Environment: Strong teamwork and diverse interactions.

- Development Opportunities: Personalized plans with rapid progression

- Versatile Career Paths: Professional growth supported by active committee for different career levels.

- Supportive Culture: High employee satisfaction and responsive feedback.

- Learning and Innovation: Continuous learning and technical training incl. subject matter experts’ trainings, soft skills and management trainings and LinkedIn learning.

- Relocation Support: Assistance for international candidates and candidates living outside of Krakow.

- Social events such as family events and charity auctions.

- Comfortable working environment (Library, relaxation area, casual dress code).

- Parking space for cars and bikes.

About Ecolab:

At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our   nearly three   million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to   eliminating   unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.

Ecolab’s commitment to diversity,   equity   and inclusion (DE&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do   what’s   right.

Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history.

Join Ecolab and help us protect   what’s   vital.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Ecolab’s industry leading Nalco Water Manufacturing team as an Operations Manager in the Indiana, Michigan, Ohio Markets.  As an Operations Manager, you will develop and lead a team of Field Service Representatives and Site Managers who provide operational capabilities along with water treatment solutions to manufacturing establishments.  Within the team, you will be responsible for leading market initial services, ensuring service excellence, pursuing sales opportunities, and performing quality assurance visits.

Additionally, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining key customer relations within your territory. You will participate in recruiting, selecting, coaching, and the performance management process.  Throughout your career, you will uphold Ecolab’s culture and policies to foster a safe and respectful work environment ensuring Ecolab’s protocols and procedures are followed.

What’s in it For You:
- The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments

- The ability to make an impact with a company that is passionate about your career development

- Enjoy a flexible, independent work environment

- Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment – medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), company paid pension, stock purchase plan, tuition reimbursement and more!

What You Will Do:
- Lead a team of 7-12 Field Service Representatives responsible for ensuring service excellence and execution.

- Manage multiple sites which have Field Service Representatives and a Site Manager

- Effectively select, train, develop and coach Site Managers and Field Service Representatives with emphasis on customer retention, growing existing accounts, add-on sales, and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction

- Take an active role in hiring, assessing, and developing associates to become the next leaders at Ecolab and Nalco

- Ensure your team of associates deliver on their scopes of work

- Pursue sales and new business opportunities

- Coordinate initial services and maintain inventory and perform QA visits

- Build and maintain customer relationships within the market

- Be a champion of safety and ensure your team upholds strong safety practices and values

- Drive sales goals for the territory while executing goals around Retain, Grow and Gain

Position Details:
- This position is based in: Tri State Area of Michigan, Indiana, and Ohio

- 50% overnight travel required - based on site demands and customer needs

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (7+ years mechanical service-related experience and 4+ years sales or leadership experience)

- Ability to lift and/or carry 50 pounds

- Current and valid driver’s license and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record

- Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role

Preferred Qualifications:
- 5+ years supervisory or team leadership experience in a field support or service role

- 2+ years of Water Treatment Experience ( Automotive manufacturing - Paint Shop Operations, Paint Decalcification, Wastewater Treatment, Reverse Osmosis, UF operations)

- Proven record of meeting customer needs, quality service delivery and meeting business objectives

- Exceptional communication and organization skills with aptitude to implement change initiatives

- Good decision-making and problem-solving skills when handling challenging situations in a fast-paced environment

- Prior experience in value added sales and/or new account generation

- Prior budget and P&L responsibilities

About Nalco Water:
In a world with increasing water shortage and contamination challenges, Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water each year. We work with customers across the world in the light industry (institutional, food & beverage, manufacturing, transportation, textile care, and global high tech) and heavy industry (chemical, downstream, paper, mining, power and primary metals industries) to reduce, reuse, and recycle their water while protecting their systems and equipment. Nalco Water provides the unique opportunity to work with a broad suite of technologies to deliver automated monitoring systems, data analysis and deep technical expertise to increase efficiency, sustainability and performance for our customers.

The total Compensation range for this position is $105,100-$157,500 which includes base pay and target incentive based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

Engineering Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Engineering Operations Manager to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operations of Ultra-Pure Water system at a customer site. In this role, you will assist with planning, coordinating, and executing daily operations and maintenance activities, while supervising technical teams and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory requirements. You will act on behalf of the Site Leader when required and play a key role in driving continuous improvement in system performance and reliability.

What You Will Do
- Assist in planning, coordinating, and monitoring daily system operations to meet production, performance, and efficiency targets.
- Support operational readiness for startups, shutdowns, and emergency situations.
- Coordinate with customer, engineering, and support teams to ensure uninterrupted operations.
- Support the development and execution of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
- Monitor equipment condition and maintenance performance to maximize asset reliability and uptime.
- Ensure timely troubleshooting and resolution of equipment and operational issues.
- Enforce company and client safety, health, and environmental (SHE) policies and regulatory requirements.
- Supervise engineers, technicians, operators, and contractors, providing technical guidance and mentorship.
- Support asset integrity, reliability initiatives, root cause failure analysis, and corrective action implementation.
- Assist with operational and maintenance planning, reporting, audits, inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Position Details
- Field-based role at a client facility.
- Monday to Friday -- 7am to 5pm
- On Call Responsibilities
- Exposure to an industrial plant environment.
- Minimal travel expected for meetings or training.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Chemical Engineering.
- 5–10 years of experience in operations and maintenance roles within an industrial or utility environment.
- 2–4 years of experience in a supervisory or leadership position.
- Strong understanding of operations and maintenance practices, plant equipment, utilities, and maintenance systems.
- Experience using CMMS/EAM systems and maintenance planning techniques.
- Strong leadership, coordination, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.
- No immigration sponsorship available for this role

Physical Demands
- Work in an industrial plant environment.
- Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and adherence to safety protocols is required.

Preferred Qualifications
- Professional certifications in maintenance or asset management (e.g., CMRP, PMP).
- Experience in water, microelectronics, utilities, chemicals, or infrastructure sectors.

Careers Advancing Ovivo by Ecolab’s Water Technology Solutions
Help shape the future of water and technology by joining a team that drives innovation in ultrapure water solutions —critical to industries powering global progress. These careers offer the chance to make an impact that matters solving complex challenges, collaborating across borders, and creating solutions that protect vital resources. If you’re passionate about water circularity, sustainability and technology, explore opportunities where your expertise fuels advancement and your growth is supported.

- Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment- medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, company paid pension, stock purchase plan, tuition reimbursement and more!
